description: Turns one product or blog link (Amazon, Etsy, Shopify, any store or blog post) into Pinterest pins with AI images, titles and descriptions. The pins keep the exact link, so an affiliate tag stays on. Uses the account's monthly pin allowance (one per pin). Takes about 2 minutes: if it is not done when this returns, call check_pins with the job_id. Pins are saved as drafts; nothing is posted.

count.description: How many pins to make, 1 to 5. Default 4.

url.description: The full link the pins should point to, e.g. https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0... or a blog post URL.

name: generate_pins
title: Make Pinterest pins from a link
